sections.heading: Jeetendra — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jeetendra was born on 7 April 1942 in Amritsar, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Ravi Kapoor at birth and is publicly known as Jeetendra.
He is a sibling of Madhubala Kapoor.
He received his education at Kishinchand Chellaram College.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.
